description: This Java class 'DefaultCalculatedFieldProcessingService' implements processing logic for calculated fields within the Thingsboard platform, including fetching arguments, processing results, and messaging related to calculated fields.

classes.name: TbCallbackWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class for TbCallback to handle success and failure callbacks in messaging operations.

methods.name: getExecutorNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix for executor thread names related to calculated field callbacks.

methods.name: fetchArguments
methods.description: Fetches arguments for a calculated field context and entity, returning a future.

methods.name: fetchDynamicArgsFromDb
methods.description: Fetches dynamic arguments from the database based on calculated field type.

methods.name: fetchPropagationArgumentFromDb
methods.description: Fetches propagation argument if the calculated field type is PROPAGATION.

methods.name: fetchRelatedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on the calculated field configuration.

methods.name: fetchArgsFromDb
methods.description: Fetches argument entries from the database for given arguments.

methods.name: fetchMetricDuringInterval
methods.description: Fetches metric data during a specified interval.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a calculated field computation, sending messages or saving telemetry as needed.

methods.name: processImmediately
methods.description: Handles immediate processing of calculated field results, such as saving telemetry or propagation results.

methods.name: pushMsgToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes calculated field results as messages to the rule engine or propagates them.

methods.name: pushMsgToLinks
methods.description: Sends messages to linked calculated fields, either broadcasting or unicasting based on entity type.

methods.name: unicast
methods.description: Sends unicast messages to specific calculated field links.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts messages to multiple calculated field links.

methods.name: buildLinkedTelemetryMsgProto
methods.description: Builds a linked telemetry message proto with links to calculated fields.
